thread:
Maria: heads-up — the JS SDK sample-runner is failing only in edge tests after I added a tiny polyfill to normalize package exports for older bundlers
Kevin: ugh, can you paste the error?
Maria: Cloudflare dev worker stacktrace: 

```
TypeError: require is not a function
    at Object.<anonymous> (dist/cjs/index.js:12:22)
    at createRuntime (worker.js:45:7)
```

Maria: but local node mocha runs fine, only the edge CI job fails
Sam: that usually means the edge bundle pulled the CJS fallback from the `exports` map 
Alex: did the polyfill rewrite `exports` to add a `default` path? that can make bundlers prefer CJS
Maria: yes — the polyfill added a compatibility block so package.json now has `"exports": { ".": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }` on top of the real conditional map (we tried to be helpful)
Kevin: ow. edge runtimes can't `require` — so runtime picks CJS path and crashes. Also TS types break because `types` still point to esm d.ts, causing mismatch in our samples
Sam: repro steps? I can check quickly in CI container
Maria: clone + run: `yarn sample-runner --target cloudflare --spec auth-retry` (fails)
Maria: quick diff of package.json before/after polyfill: 

```
- "exports": {
-   ".": {
-     "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
-     "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
-   }
- }
+ "exports": "./dist/cjs/index.js" // polyfill flattened it
```

Alex: flattening kills conditional resolution. We need explicit `import` vs `require` and probably a `browser` conditional for edge bundlers
Kevin: options: revert polyfill and add a compatibility shim in our sample bundler, or change package.json to keep full conditional exports and teach our old bundlers to honor them
Sam: /cc @ci-bot — we should mark edge test as blocked until fix is merged? it keeps spamming flakes
ci-bot: CI job #4821 marked flaky (edge-cloudflare-auth-retry). Re-running pending on review label `devex/exportmap-fix`
Maria: patch idea: set `exports` back to conditional, and add an explicit top-level `browser` field: 

```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "browser": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

Alex: that looks good. also add a short note in the onboarding README telling users to use `"module"`/`import` path on edge, and pin the sample-runner bundler to prefer `import` when `browser` exists
Kevin: also add a TS smoke test — compile samples against `types` to catch the d.ts/CJS mismatch earlier
Sam: I can open a PR for the sample-runner config + CI label, Maria can revert the polyfill in SDK package.json and Alex can add the README note
Maria: thanks — will open PR for revert in the SDK now. Leaving a TODO to audit other packages where our 'helpful' polyfill ran
Alex: long-term: maybe add a lint rule that rejects flattened `exports` or warns when `exports` is a string instead of conditional map
Maria: agreed. creating a GH issue after PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
